method: Preliminary numerical MTF and held-out coherent SSA1 comparison at fixed effective current stress and sea state.

validation.meaning: Finite declared-valid outputs, graph-coordinate consistency, and derivative-partition closure when coherent velocities are available; not electromagnetic, hydrodynamic, or GMF validation.

opposite_lobe_dependence: Opposite spatial lobes of each real surface have identical roughness envelopes and are NOT independent MTF observations; coherent opposite-look Doppler remains separately evaluated
velocity_description: Full parent material-coordinate xt,yt,zt reconstructed with full amplitude rates; evaluated on saved grid and mapped to fixed laboratory coordinates. Eulerian saved mean current is separate. Exact graph-motion decomposition, not an assertion that xt,yt,zt equal the complete fluid orbital velocity.
highlights: 12 of 12 directions support the MTF fit; 12 support a held-out coherent comparison.
Regression coefficients use roughness and slopes; Doppler is evaluated as a separate diagnostic.
limitations: Finite deterministic periodic patch; conditional held-out times do not establish independent sea-state validation
Local spatial Bragg envelopes cannot identify opposite-traveling free/bound populations
MTF regression predicts an orbital correction only; no total Doppler or calibrated U10 relationship claimed
Parent and local-band scales must be separated; repeat bandwidth, patch, resolution, and temporal-block sensitivity studies
SSA1 lacks shadowing, multiple scattering, foam, and wave-breaking physics; dielectric precision at Ka is uncertain
Incidence-only first-order tilt and one propagation-axis MTF need not describe strong slopes or crossing waves; slope-induced local azimuth rotation is not modelled
Weak-return masks use only training thresholds; insufficient heldout samples are reported rather than assigned zero error
No velocity is divided by the paper Stokes proxy to infer mr; normalization convention therefore does not create a factor-of-two ambiguity
Scientific status remains preliminary even when numerical presentation checks pass. This is not an absolute wind-speed GMF calibration.
Friction velocity parameterizes current-delivered effective water-side stress only; no direct aerodynamic growth is supplied to the parent waves or Cho.
The fields labelled orbital in source diagnostics are parent material-coordinate motion. They are not rigorously established as the complete fluid velocity.
MTF plots use viewing azimuth at fixed case settings, not U10. No wind-speed dependence or confidence interval is manufactured from one case.
The independent comparison means an independently differentiated coherent return and data withheld from coefficient fitting; nearby times are not independent sea-state realizations.

figures.title: Measured modulation coefficients
figures.caption: Numerical m_r and m_i versus radar viewing azimuth at the fixed case settings. Gray crosses mark unavailable directions. Vertical intervals appear only when supplied by the temporal-block analysis; they are conditional within this realization, not ensemble or model confidence.

figures.title: Held-out modulation test
figures.caption: The left panel compares time-mean covariances on the held-out interval. The right panel compares valid held-out frame diagnostics. The MTF is fitted from roughness and parent slopes, not from these velocity covariances.

figures.title: MTF prediction versus coherent Doppler
figures.caption: The coherent comparison uses the derivative contribution formed from parent material-coordinate motion, h_t = w − u h_x − v h_y on the selected surface. These u,v,w are not asserted to be the complete fluid orbital velocity. Aggregates use the same coherent-power time weights; temporal holdout is conditional within the realization.

figures.title: Total return and motion contributions
figures.caption: Signed components share the same coherent scattering amplitude and sum to the total. The parent-coordinate motion already contains its supplied amplitude-rate history. The residual closes the graph evolution and must not be interpreted as an isolated intrinsic-wave velocity.

figures.title: Effect of adding Cho
figures.caption: Both analyses use matching radar geometry, propagation axis, and train/test time windows. Available history hashes are checked for agreement. Invalid directional values remain masked; no result is invented for a missing parent-only analysis.
